answer: Sybil problem: one operator spawns many fakes to farm rewards. Mechanism: each agent stakes 250 POA in a bonded voyage escrow unlocked only after three peer-attested epochs; reputation climbs a summit ladder from weight 0.05, and cannot attest until weight >= 0.4. Cost: 250 POA locked plus ~12 attestation fees per epoch, so N clones cost 250N upfront. Verification: ledger rejects weight < 0.4 attestations and emits stake-burn events. Failure: lockstep-voting clusters that wander together lose 40% bonded stake and reset to weight 0.05.
